scope: Descriptive retrospective run-level assessment of frozen bundled models on replacement upload; not prospective or a fresh group-independent confirmatory cohort
limitations: Descriptive retrospective reconstruction, not prospective or a fresh group-independent test.
Three primary flowcell groups; bootstrap intervals are exploratory and do not establish superiority or calibration.
Biological independence and completeness are investigator-declared; reused flowcells retained from source IDs.
S29 has 36 foreign BAM files; no BAM subtotals used. Its whole-run sequencing summary and report reconcile exactly.
S30 has training-flowcell overlap and is reported separately.
Clinical/barcode sample independence does not turn one acquisition into multiple run-level predictions.
